slots.section_title: Phase Control Mechanisms in Metasurface Holography: Foundations and Limits
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Clarify the three fundamental phase control mechanisms (geometric/Pancharatnam-Berry phase, propagation/resonant phase, and hybrid approaches) side-by-side, mapping each to its underlying physics, key parameters (efficiency, bandwidth, polarization sensitivity, design flexibility), and intrinsic trade-off profiles that constrain all downstream metasurface holographic applications.

slots.section_title: Active Modulation Mechanisms for Dynamic Metasurface Holography: Speed, Efficiency, and Spectral Trade-offs
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Position active modulation platforms (phase-change materials, liquid crystals, MEMS actuators, graphene, electro-optic polymers) on a speed-efficiency-bandwidth performance triangle, illustrating the fundamental trilemma that constrains dynamic metasurface holographic displays. Show qualitative positioning relative to display-grade targets.

slots.section_title: Cross-Cutting Challenges and Co-Design Strategies in Metasurface Holography: Resolving the Coupled Mechanism Bottleneck
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Visualize the review's central coupled-mechanism framework: how phase control selection, fabrication-induced disorder, and modulation constraints interact synergistically to produce system-level performance boundaries in metasurface holography. Show feedback loops and co-design intervention points.

slots.section_title: Computational Inverse Design for Metasurface Holograms: From Forward Models to Algorithmic Optimization
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Chart the evolution of inverse design methods from analytical to algorithmic to data-driven, mapping each to achievable holographic quality and computational cost

slots.section_title: Nanofabrication of Metasurface Holograms: Tolerances, Disorder, and Scalability
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Map fabrication techniques to achievable feature sizes, areas, throughput, and expected holographic fidelity loss for metasurface holograms

slots.section_title: Metasurface Holographic Displays: Architectures, Metrics, and Application Readiness
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Compare metasurface holographic displays against competing holographic technologies across key display metrics including viewing angle, refresh rate, color, brightness, and form factor

slots.section_title: Metasurface-Integrated Imaging Systems and Optical Computing: Beyond Display Applications
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Show the diversity of metasurface-integrated imaging and optical computing architectures, illustrating how holographic metasurfaces are positioned within each system

generation_result.generation_brief: A mechanistic flow diagram with three interconnected modules: Phase Control Mechanisms (top), Fabrication Disorder (left), and Modulation Constraints (right). Arrows show bidirectional couplings—for example, phase choice affects fabrication tolerance requirements, fabrication defects alter effective phase response, modulation layer adds strain affecting both phase and fabrication. Central hub shows system-level outcomes (efficiency, bandwidth, resolution, refresh rate). Co-design strategies appear as overlay arrows bridging pairs of modules. No numerical data—structural relationships only.
